findings.title: Explicit empty --base must not produce NOT_REQUIRED
findings.resolution: The implementer changed impact.main to test args.base is not None and added a public CLI regression. Omitted-base changed-file mode remains supported.
findings.independently_verified: Explicit empty base, nonexistent base and nonexistent head all return nonzero without stdout receipt or GitHub output; omitted base with an owned changed-file returns required=true.

spec_checks.requirement: Git raw-path correctness and fail-closed comparison
spec_checks.evidence: CLI three-dot comparison against a divergent base returned exactly five expected raw paths, including Unicode/tab/quote/literal-backslash/trailing-space and old/new rename surfaces; newline-containing names did not add GitHub output lines. Literal unowned names remained unowned. Non-UTF8 paths and invalid refs failed without emitting a receipt.
spec_checks.nul_scope: Git filenames cannot contain NUL; the code uses Git's NUL framing to preserve filename boundaries. Real Git fixtures exercised that framing.

spec_checks.requirement: Bounded gate process lifecycle and output
spec_checks.evidence: Exact 2 MiB stdout plus 64 KiB stderr succeeds; exceeding either limit by one byte fails with output-budget. A parent that already exited while a child retained inherited pipes failed with timeout in 1.0136 seconds and the child did not write its delayed marker. The output-overflow path failed in 0.0752 seconds and also removed the descendant.
spec_checks.boundary: POSIX same-process-group cleanup only; deliberately detached sessions and Windows process trees are outside this reviewed guarantee.

spec_checks.requirement: No stale pass from production gates with undeclared inputs
